simple.meaning: מַלְכִּיָּה (Malkîyâh) appears 16 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, Jeremiah, beginning at 1 Chronicles 6:25. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַלְכִּיָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

timeline.evidenceText: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, and Izziah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired another portion, and the tower of the furnaces.
Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.

Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

definitions.short: Malkijah , the name of ten Israelites
definitions.full: H4441. Malkiyyah or Malkiyahu מַלְכִּיָּהוּ (only Jer 38:6 ), מַלְכִּיָּה proper name, masculine ( my king is Yah ; compare Gray Prop. N. 119 f., 146 and elsewhere ); — ᵐ5 Μελχ ( ε ) ια ( ς ). — 1 father of Pashhur Jer 21:1 ; 38:1 , compare 1Chr 9:12 (priest), Neh 11:12 . 2 a prince Jer 38:6 . 3 priests: a. 1Chr 24:9 . b. Neh 12:42 . 4 one of the sealed Neh 10:4 ; perhaps also 8:4 . 5 a Levite 1Chr 6:25 . 6 various men: a. Ezra 10:25 a. b. Ezra 10:25 b. c. Ezra 10:31 = Neh 3:11 . d. Neh 3:14 . e. Neh 3:31 .
definitions.rootNote: or מַלְכִּיָּהוּ lemma מַלְכִּיָהוּ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלְכִּיָּהוּ ; (Jeremiah 38:6), from 4428 and 3050 ; king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah ;
